run_hydra_pipeline: run the hydra-integrated spdl pipeline example that instantiates and iterates over pipeline items
instantiate_pipeline_cfg: instantiate a pipeline configuration object from a Hydra YAML config using hydra.utils.instantiate
instantiate_pipeline: instantiate an spdl Pipeline object from a Hydra YAML config using hydra.utils.instantiate
iterate_pipeline_items: iterate over pipeline items using pipeline.get_iterator with a timeout inside an auto_stop context
review_main_entry: review the main entry point that loads Hydra config and runs an spdl pipeline
